description: A host's telemetry switched on or off, or what a process on its machine profiles set, at run time: kept by the host, and told to its machine's apps (Info's telemetry).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

on.description: Telemetry on or off (null: as it is).

app.description: The process whose profiling is set: the host's, Baude's or Record's (null: none).

functions.description: What it profiles: functions and modules by their dotted names; empty: off.
